```yaml
name: CI Pipeline

on:
  push:
    branches: [ main, master ]
  pull_request:
    branches: [ main, master ]

jobs:
  ci:
    runs-on: macos-latest

    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.11'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          python -m pip install --upgrade pip
          if [ -f requirements.txt ]; then pip install -r requirements.txt; fi
          if [ -f pyproject.toml ]; then pip install .; fi
          pip install pytest ruff

      - name: Run Ruff linter
        uses: astral-sh/ruff-action@v3
        with:
          args: "check"

      - name: Run Ruff formatter check
        uses: astral-sh/ruff-action@v3
        with:
          args: "format --check"

      - name: Run Pytest
        run: |
          pytest

      - name: Run Path Consistency Checker
        run: |
          chmod +x scripts/check-path-consistency.sh
          bash scripts/check-path-consistency.sh

      - name: Run Enhanced Distribution Checks
        run: |
          chmod +x scripts/verify-distribution.sh
          bash scripts/verify-distribution.sh
```

          if [ -f pyproject.toml ]; then pip install .; fi
          pip install pytest ruff

      - name: Run Ruff linter
        uses: astral-sh/ruff-action@v3
        with:
          args: "check"

      - name: Run Ruff formatter check
        uses: astral-sh/ruff-action@v3
        with:
          args: "format --check"

      - name: Run Pytest
        run: |
          pytest

      - name: Run Path Consistency Checker
